name: walk_stairs_down
text: Starting on the TOP landing of an eight-step staircase, immediately walk steadily FORWARDS DOWN the stairs. Take eight equally timed alternating steps during the first four seconds, one tread per step, each tread nineteen centimetres lower and thirty-eight centimetres forwards. Lower the pelvis progressively at the same even rate as the steps, transferring weight onto each lower tread. Keep the torso upright and arms swinging gently beside the body. Reach the BOTTOM flat ground at four seconds, then stand there naturally for the final second. No initial waiting, hopping, crouching or sitting.

review.reason: The old assistant visual verdict lacks current per-activity final-runtime review evidence. Image existence and the generic batch note do not establish movement quality. This withdrawal does not assert that the motion is faulty.

visual_review.method: Visual review only. Initial whole-duration chronological overview at 5 fps, followed by full 30 fps sequences and close-ups where needed. No numerical quality gates or tests. Real-time viewing unavailable; do not claim live playback.
visual_review.observation: Whole overview 225/90, 0-5 s. Descends but both railings obscure most foot contacts. Need front elevated angle. Elevated view: alternating descent and walkout.
visual_review.scope: The old assistant approval was withdrawn after missed activity and contact failures. Retained observations describe their historical scope and do not approve the current version.
